title: The realized evolution minimizes a storage-plus-flux action

statements.text: Among admissible evolutions, the realized one is assumed to minimize an action $S[C, J] = \int \int (\Phi(C) + \tfrac{1}{2} J^\top M(C)^{-1} J) \, dx \, dt$, with a storage functional $\Phi$ and a positive definite mobility $M$.
